about: The user's own landmarks: a name a player knows and its zone, as the game names them (English). kind: place (an area: where its creatures gather most, else its middle), peak (an area seen as its highest ground: a volcano, a mountain), npc or object; without it, place, npc, then object. hint: a note for the reader (where, why), not read by the picker. scripts/pick.ts finds each in wow-data (its card's resolver), places it where the game has it and looks for a camera on it as on a camp (src/extras.ts). Never copied from another site's list.

landmarks.name: Fire Plume Ridge
landmarks.hint: the volcano in the crater's middle

landmarks.name: Marshal's Refuge
landmarks.hint: the camp in the cave mouth on the north wall

landmarks.name: Itharius
